LanguageData.DMS_Arsenal_ExpiredText: The survey records on the old arsenal have gone stale. The site's position is lost.
LanguageData.DMS_Arsenal_ClearedText: The gravekeepers walking the old arsenal are down and the site's defences have fallen silent.\n\nThe bunker seals still hold. Use the decoy radar on the central pad to call a tarbosaurus here and destroy it, then hack each bunker's security console to open its blast door and see what was left behind.
LanguageData.DMS_Arsenal_EntryCountdownText: You have entered the old arsenal. Its unmanned security network has flagged your presence.\n\nEnemy reinforcements will arrive in {0}. Deal with the gravekeepers, call in and destroy the tarbosaurus, and get into the bunkers before then.
LanguageData.DMS_ArsenalPatrol_Challenge: A gravekeeper has stopped to challenge {0}. Gravekeepers hold fire unless they are attacked, an intruder enters a bunker, a bunker seal is broken or the facility alert runs high.
LanguageData.DMS_ArsenalPatrol_Search: A bunker seal has been broken. The gravekeepers are sweeping the compound.
